dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Goh. Thank you for making time for our arranged discussion. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel. Just came in from the garden lah. Was clearing the pots outside, but I've washed up and got my papers beside me.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a busy start to the day. Have you been doing much gardening recently?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Quite a bit lately. The herbs taking over already. Nice to do something away from the office, though clearing up afterwards takes longer than the gardening itself.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I hope you've had a chance to sit down. Before we begin, is this generally a convenient part of the day for routine banking calls?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Afternoons usually better leh. In the morning got staff coming in with questions. A message before calling would help, then I can find somewhere quiet instead of walking around the office.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that scheduling preference. For today, I'll keep the discussion focused and leave room for any administrative points. We can start with your identification details.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Got the details here. My FIN is F five nine four seven four five four X. My date of birth is 23 November 1995.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll turn to the investment discussion now. Your investment objective is to seek income and diversify through emerging-market debt, while accepting fluctuations in valuation. With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, emerging-market issuers may default or their credit quality may deteriorate, reducing the value of the fund's bond holdings. Do you understand how issuer defaults or deteriorating credit quality could reduce the value of this fund?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. If the issuers cannot pay or their credit quality gets worse, the fund value can drop. Office quite quiet now lah, so I can hear you clearly.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.5%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including the possible loss of your invested capital?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept losses on the capital I invest. The value moving around, I can accept that too. My notes are beside me already.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend investing in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market debt exposure supports your income objective, while its managed portfolio spreads your exposure across issuers.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Let me turn to the right page first ah. Got a few papers mixed in with my gardening list.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please take your time. The proposed subscription quantity is 10,000 units, for your consideration.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Found the page already. For the fund, I want Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. For this transaction, use Chinese yuan. The amount I want to invest is 2,500,000. For the quantity, use what you proposed just now lah. I want to buy, not dispose of a holding. Make it a market order for this transaction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Let me read back the fund and quantity: Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, for 10,000 units.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Wait, the fund name wrong leh. I meant Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I apologize for that error. With the product name corrected, please explicitly confirm whether you authorize the complete transaction instruction as it now stands.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me think a bit first ah. Got a message coming in.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. I can stay on the line while you check your message.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Aiyoh, office needs me to look at something. Can we leave the conversation here for now? Hard to concentrate with people sending messages like this.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll let you attend to that. Thank you for your time today, Adrian.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. Sorry about the interruption ah. Speak another time.
